known_issue.description: family filter (--prt-sidecar-apply-family) controls apply but not load. All families in manifest still load and consume memory even when requesting a specific family.
known_issue.evidence: E test: wrong_family requested but attn_out, ffn_up, ffn_down all still activated (activation_successes>=1 for each)
known_issue.impact: Memory inflation when requesting specific families; load filter bug
